## Context
Story: ef22-d1de-565c-4f29 — detect-session-leakage.sh at 3 invocation points + closed-bug-trailer race protection

## Goal
Update SKILL.md: add detect-session-leakage.sh calls (1) after each fix-bug in Bug-Fix Mode, (2) after each Phase F/G batch, (3) at Phase K final sweep; all calls use STORY_BRANCH_PREFIX=bug-batch/; document closed-bug-trailer race protection.

## Testing Mode: UPDATE

## File Impact
| Source File | Action | Test File | Classification |
|---|---|---|---|
| plugins/dso/skills/debug-everything/SKILL.md | modify | tests/scripts/test-debug-everything-leak-detection.sh | needs-modification |
| .test-index | modify | n/a | n/a |

## Implementation Steps
1. Bug-Fix Mode per-ticket loop: after each fix-bug invocation, add:
   ```bash
   STORY_BRANCH_PREFIX=bug-batch/ bash "$PLUGIN_SCRIPTS/detect-session-leakage.sh" 2>&1 || log warning
   ```
   Non-fatal: log warning on non-zero exit; do NOT halt the loop

2. Phase F/G batch completion: after each batch merge, add the same detect-session-leakage.sh call with STORY_BRANCH_PREFIX=bug-batch/

3. Phase K: before lock release, add a final sweep:
   ```bash
   STORY_BRANCH_PREFIX=bug-batch/ bash "$PLUGIN_SCRIPTS/detect-session-leakage.sh" 2>&1 || true
   ```

4. Closed-bug-trailer race: add documentation:
   'When a sub-agent commit references a ticket closed during parallel batch execution, the commit's DSO-Bug: trailer references a closed ticket. Route to --force-route-to-pending state: log SHA + closed-ticket-id and flag for post-session manual attribution rather than stalling integration.'

Remove RED markers for test_leak_detection_* and test_closed_bug_trailer_race_protection from .test-index

## Acceptance Criteria
- SKILL.md Bug-Fix Mode references detect-session-leakage.sh after each fix-bug
- SKILL.md Phase F/G references detect-session-leakage.sh after each batch
- SKILL.md Phase K references detect-session-leakage.sh final sweep
- SKILL.md references STORY_BRANCH_PREFIX=bug-batch/ for leak detection
- SKILL.md documents --force-route-to-pending for closed-bug-trailer race
- All 5 structural tests pass GREEN
- ruff checks pass
